en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional dance song. 'тук'' I read as 'but/only'.

lines.cyr: Оди бре либе, оди кај ќе одиш,
lines.lat: Odi bre libe, odi kaj ḱe odiš,
lines.en: Go on, hey love, go wherever you go,

lines.cyr: ти при мене, либе ле, пак ќе се вратиш.
lines.lat: ti pri mene, libe le, pak ḱe se vratiš.
lines.en: you will come back to me anyway, my love.

lines.cyr: На орото, либе, не се фаќај до мене,
lines.lat: Na oroto, libe, ne se faḱaj do mene,
lines.en: At the dance, love, do not hold on next to me,

lines.cyr: тук' се фати, либе ле, ти спроти мене.
lines.lat: tuk' se fati, libe le, ti sproti mene.
lines.en: but hold on, my love, opposite me.

lines.cyr: Дигни очи, либе, ти погледни ме,
lines.lat: Digni oči, libe, ti pogledni me,
lines.en: Lift your eyes, love, and look at me,

lines.cyr: скрши веѓи, либе ле, ти намигни ми.
lines.lat: skrši veǵi, libe le, ti namigni mi.
lines.en: knit your brows, my love, and wink at me.
